support_claim: Commercial notes state that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity, the MSA-HELION-2019 contract names Helion Robotics Ltd as counterparty, and billing records bill Helion Robotics Limited, establishing that both referents denote that single counterparty.

critic.reason: The packet cites the MSA counterparty as Helion Robotics Ltd., billing records as Helion Robotics Limited, and commercial notes explicitly state those names are the same legal entity, which together establish the proposed SAME_ENTITY disposition.
